subject: Next steps: Synthly token targets & model allocation (recap)
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel@synthly.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: ava.brooks@synthly.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + numbers from this morning

Laura / Monica — thanks for the call today. Quick capture of what we said so we have alignment before the deeper technical session.

Summary from Synthly's side:
- Pilot target: 8M tokens/month for 3 months (internal KPIs: latency <350ms 95th, relevance uplift target ~12%).
- Steady-state expected: 45–60M tokens/month within 12 months if pilot succeeds.
- Budget range for pilot: $4k–$6k/month; target commercial fit for scale: target $/1M tokens in the $50–$80 range (we understand there will be tradeoffs by model).
- Model mix (approx): chat generation ~65% of token volume, embeddings (for similarity + semantic search) ~20% by call volume (lower token count), rerank calls ~15% (higher CPU per call).

Open asks for Redwood:
1) Per-1M token price bands for hosted vs dedicated for the model mix above.
2) Quick proposal for initial routing (chat primary model + lower-cost fallback, embeddings model, rerank option) — we need latency/cost guidance.
3) SOC 2 evidence + basic procurement items for next-week review by our finance team.

I attached a short MAPP doc that shows our expected call patterns. We'll be ready to schedule the tech deep-dive after we see a simple price band and a short SOW draft.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Cho
Head of Product
Synthly

Attachments: Synthly_MAPP_v1.pdf (1 page), Synthly_system_diagram.png (referenced)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Cho <daniel@synthly.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + numbers from this morning

Thanks Daniel — great to meet the team. Recap + what we can offer as a next step.

High-level price guidance (ballpark; we will produce a formal quote):
- Hosted (no commit):
  - Typical mix (rw-large-v2-chat quantized for production, rw-embed-1 for vectors, rw-rerank-compact): ~$75 per 1M tokens (weighted average, includes embedding compute amortized).
  - For pilot volumes (up to 10M/mo) we can offer a promotional pilot rate: $60 per 1M tokens for three months (see attached pricing calc).
- Dedicated / Reserved (3–12 month commit):
  - With a modest commit we can get to ~$35–$45 per 1M tokens depending on traffic shape and batching (we'll model this in the quote).

Model routing suggestion (initial):
- Chat: default to rw-large-v2-chat-quantized (primary). Non-critical/background generation -> rw-small-chat as low-cost fallback.
- Embeddings: rw-embed-1 (we price embeddings per-vector but call volume is lower; include batching to reduce per-call overhead).
- Rerank: rw-rerank-compact for most traffic; high-quality reranks can be routed to rw-large-rerank if needed for top-n.

Suggested per-model token split (weighted by token consumption):
- Chat generation: 70% of tokens
- Embedding & semantic search requests: 12% of tokens (but billed per-vector; see calc)
- Rerank: 18% of tokens (higher CPU density, smaller token counts per call)

Operational levers to lower unit costs: prefix caching for repeated prompts, KV cache for session memory, and smart batching at the inference layer — these typically reduce the effective $/1M by ~15–25% depending on hit rates.

Next steps we propose:
1) I will send a short quote + SOW draft (redwood-pricing-calc.xlsx attached) by EOD today.
2) Technical deep-dive (solutions + infra) — can you do Wed 10/22 10:00 AM PT? Monica will lead.
3) Procurement checklist (SOC 2, IP addendum, standard contract) — Marcus to provide template comments.

Happy to discuss adjustments — if the budget target is firmly $50/1M at scale, Marcus and I can talk about an intro reserved tier structure that lands there with a reasonable commit.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-pricing-calc.xlsx (pricing calculator), quick-terms-one-pager.pdf (referenced)

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: suggested commercial for SYN-2026-042

Looping in internal ask/strategy for this opportunity (internal only).

Notes:
- Deal context: Product-led startup, quick decision cycle but tight budget for initial pilot. Good expansion upside (healthcare vertical integrations later).
- Recommended pilot commercial: 3-month pilot, 8M tokens/mo, fixed pilot price $3,600/month (effective $45 per 1M tokens) + $15k one-time onboarding credit if they commit to technical deep-dive and sign the SOW within 30 days. Pilot credit reduces first invoice.
- If they commit to a 6–12 month reserved capacity within 60 days of pilot start, offer laddered discounts to reach $30–$40 per 1M tokens depending on commit and traffic SLAs.
- Ask Legal to prepare a short pilot SOW and procurement checklist; ask Security to hand SOC 2 Type II and the standard data flow diagram.

Operational notes for Monica (SE):
- For the tech deep-dive prepare a routing playbook showing latency/cost tradeoffs for rw-large-v2-chat (quantized) vs rw-small-chat, and a simple simulation showing expected monthly costs under the 8M -> 50M growth curve.
- Flag any embedding throughput limits: ensure 10k vectors/sec SLA for peak testing.

I'll be on the call Wed to support commercial framing.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, West | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Daniel Cho <daniel@synthly.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ava.brooks@synthly.ai, procurement@synthly.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Synthly token targets & model allocation (recap)

Laura / Marcus / Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the pilot offer. A couple quick confirmations before we lock calendar: 

1) Pilot acceptance: Synthly agrees to the 3-month pilot at 8M tokens/mo at $45 per 1M (total $3,600/mo) provided the onboarding credit is applied to month 1. Procurement will need a short SOW and a payment schedule.
2) Technical deep-dive: Wed 10/22 10:00 AM PT works for us — Monica please send the invite. We'll include our infra lead (Ava) and procurement.
3) SOC 2 + procurement: procurement@synthly.ai needs the SOC 2 artifact and a vendor contact for PO routing.

A few clarifying details on model mix for the pilot (to set expectations):
- Chat traffic will be ~70% of token consumption; most calls are short multi-turn sessions (~150 tokens/session).
- Embedding calls will be lower token volume but higher call count for search indexing jobs (batching ok).
- Rerank will be used for top-N candidate scoring; expect bursts tied to user sessions.

Please send the SOW + quote and I'll route internally. Once procurement signs off we can start the pilot within two weeks.

Thanks,
Daniel
Head of Product, Synthly
daniel@synthly.ai

Attachments: Synthly_SOW_draft.docx (placeholder SOW sent on request)
